parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token. It is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The ClientToken parameter can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: InputParameters
parameters.description: The input parameters of the rule.

parameters.name: MemberId
parameters.description: This parameter is scheduled to be deprecated at 00:00:00 on June 30, 2021. The API of the alternative feature, account group, is released at 00:00:00 on May 30, 2021. If you are using this parameter, we recommend that you switch to the API of the account group feature after 00:00:00 on May 30, 2021. For more information about account groups, see [Account group](~~211534~~).

parameters.name: MultiAccount
parameters.description: This parameter is scheduled to be deprecated at 00:00:00 on June 30, 2021. The API of the alternative feature, account group, is released at 00:00:00 on May 30, 2021. If you are using this parameter, we recommend that you switch to the API of the account group feature after 00:00:00 on May 30, 2021. For more information about account groups, see [Account group](~~211534~~).

parameters.name: RiskLevel
parameters.description:
The risk level. Valid values:

- 1: high risk.

- 2: medium risk.

- 3: low risk.

parameters.name: ScopeComplianceResourceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the resource to be evaluated.

- If you leave this parameter empty, the rule evaluates all resources of the resource types specified by the ScopeComplianceResourceTypes parameter.

- If you specify this parameter, the rule evaluates only the specified resource.

parameters.name: ScopeComplianceResourceTypes
parameters.description: The types of the resources to be evaluated.

parameters.name: SourceDetailMessageType
parameters.description:
The trigger type of the rule. Valid values:

- ConfigurationItemChangeNotification: The rule is triggered by configuration changes.

- ScheduledNotification: The rule is triggered periodically.

parameters.name: SourceIdentifier
parameters.description:
The identifier of the rule.

- If the rule is a managed rule, the value of this parameter is the identifier of the managed rule.

- If the rule is a user-defined function, the value of this parameter is the Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the function.

parameters.name: SourceMaximumExecutionFrequency
parameters.description:
The frequency at which the rule is executed. Valid values:

- One\_Hour: 1 hour.

- Three\_Hours: 3 hours.

- Six\_Hours: 6 hours.

- Twelve\_Hours: 12 hours.

- TwentyFour\_Hours: 24 hours.

parameters.name: SourceOwner
parameters.description:
The owner of the rule. Valid values:

- CUSTOM\_FC: user-defined function.

- ALIYUN: managed rule.
